answer: Admission runs on one live phone line per key. At join the node calls the number and reads a six digit nonce aloud; the applicant types it back within 30 seconds, and that line stays bound. Carriers reissue dormant numbers, so the check repeats every 45 days, and VoIP ranges are refused, which leaves real SIMs. Fifty clones need fifty SIMs at $3 each plus $6 monthly plans, near $450 in month one, and fifty callbacks answered by a person, roughly two operator hours a day. A falcon keeps one ledge. A delta splits silt around every sandbar it meets, and a grove holds one seed per stem.
